title: aethionema rotundifolium
intro: Aethionema rotundifolium, commonly known as Rock Cress, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Brassicaceae. The Rock Cress plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rock Cress include its ability to relieve coughs, ease congestion, and support immune function. Bioactive constituents of Rock Cress include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
